title: Remove rear main seal and crankshaft flange area

notices.text: The RMS is the 996's most over-blamed and most misunderstood leak. LN's position is worth repeating: RMS leaks are not caused by the weight of the dual-mass flywheel, they come from case/block mis-machining at the factory or from an engine never updated to the current PTFE seal. Note carefully whether the old seal sat square in its bore. A PTFE seal is installed DRY — no oil, no grease on the lip — and must go in square with the proper tool, never tapped in with a socket.

steps.text: Remove rear main seal and crankshaft flange area.
